Burden of five hospital infections in Germany and the EU/EEA

hai_burden.Rd

Published estimates of five infections that patients catch in hospital. Each estimate is a yearly rate per 100,000 people. The numbers come from hospital surveys in 2011 and 2012. Each row is one infection in one survey sample for one measure.

Usage

hai_burden

Format

A tibble with 45 rows and 6 columns.

survey

Survey sample. Germany (national sample) is the main German estimate. Germany (convenience sample) is a second and larger German sample. EU/EEA average is the European estimate.

infection

Type of hospital infection.

measure

What is counted. Infections is the number of new cases. Deaths is the number of deaths caused by the infection. DALYs is the number of healthy years lost.

estimate

Median estimate per 100,000 people each year.

lower

Lower limit of the 95% uncertainty interval.

upper

Upper limit of the 95% uncertainty interval.

Source

Table 2 of Zacher et al. (2019), Eurosurveillance 24(46), https://doi.org/10.2807/1560-7917.ES.2019.24.46.1900135

Details

The numbers are model estimates and not direct counts. A DALY adds the years lost to early death and the years lived in poor health.
